component.name: Root
component.summary: Chat, voice and video for communities

description.p: This is a community package of Root, maintained independently and unaffiliated with Root. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
Root is a home for online communities: text channels, voice and video calls, screen sharing and direct messages, with apps from the Root App Store running inside a community.

Sandbox: network, X11 display and GPU, audio, notifications and the tray icon. Files are attached and saved through the file chooser. Root's window runs through X11 (XWayland on a Wayland desktop). The in-app updater is not available in this package; updates come through FlatPark.
Root's embedded browser runs without its own Chromium sandbox, which cannot start inside Flatpak; the Flatpak sandbox still applies.
The camera is not granted by default. For video calls, enable it with: flatpak override --user --device=all com.rootapp.Root (undo with flatpak override --user --reset com.rootapp.Root).
